known_limits: Fingerprint binding (data pointer, version counter, shape) does not detect writes through `.data` between the pre- and post-schedule full-hash checks; only the full SHA-256 checks before and after each timing schedule can detect them.
`slot_offsets` (arange(256)) is an additional load-time cache of the tree variants that section 3.2 does not list; the reference builds it on every call (cost about 1 microsecond).
RNG-unchanged checks that sit inside an isolated-RNG block cannot observe RNG use, because the block restores the generator state on exit; no variant uses RNG.
